title: A new look: one colour per floor
text: Floorboard got a redesign. The floors sit in one switcher at the top, each with its own colour. The library floats beside the plan with a search field and category chips, and a camera now has its own inspector: body, lens set, focal lengths as chips, squeeze and the field of view at a glance. New typeface, a calmer canvas and a refined dark mode.

title: Pro is €7 a month, and the first month is free
text: Every new account gets a free month with every floor, no card and nothing that renews by itself. After that Pro is €7 a month or €77 a year, billed by Paddle with VAT handled. If you stop, your productions stay stored for a year. Also new: museum benches, poufs, paintings, radiators and built-in closets in the library.

title: Floor Scanner: the iPhone companion for scouting
text: Scan a room with LiDAR or measure it with the camera, photograph the location through a director's viewfinder with real lens sets, export a PDF — and, signed in, find it all in Floorboard's room library. Coming to the App Store; TestFlight first.

title: Templates and an example production
text: New productions start from a template — commercial, brand film, documentary, fiction, music video, socials — with the right tools laid out on every floor. Or open “Haver”, a 15-second commercial with five shots in three locations, to see how the floors connect.

title: Floor access per co-editor
text: Invite crew without the Budget and Production floors, or switch any floor on or off per member. Rooms scanned on the iPhone level themselves; the whole selection can now be turned with a handle that snaps to 90°.

title: Floorboard has six floors
text: FLOOR Studio became Floorboard: Mood, Script, Shot designer, Shot list, Budget and Production, each a floor of the same building. New logo, new document PDFs in your house style, a budget laid out like a quote.
